title: Privacy-First Resume Builder With No Login Required
description: Build and edit a full resume or cover letter instantly in the browser: no account, no email, and no payment wall to get started.
fullDescription: VeriWorkly is a privacy-first resume builder: every document is written to the browser's local storage first, so a visitor can start editing a resume or cover letter the moment the page loads. There is no signup wall, no email capture, and no trial countdown blocking the core editor. A 30-day guest session keeps work persisted for logged-out users, and login is only ever required for optional cloud sync, sharing, AI features, ATS scoring, imports, and portfolio publishing.
whyItMatters: Most resume builders force an account (and often a card) before letting anyone see the product. That friction costs first-time visitors exactly when they're most likely to convert into long-term users. A local-first, no-login core keeps VeriWorkly's free tier genuinely usable and builds trust before asking for anything.
timeline: Shipped in the initial v1.0.0 release cycle alongside routing, SEO, and Docker infrastructure work.

details.problem: Most resume builders require an account: and often payment: before a visitor can even see the editor, creating friction at the exact moment someone is deciding whether to trust the product.
details.approach: Store all document data in the browser via local storage first, with a persisted 30-day guest session so logged-out users never lose work, and gate only cloud-dependent features (sync, sharing, AI, ATS, imports, publishing) behind login.
details.solution: A local-first architecture that lets anyone open the app and start building immediately, with login positioned as an optional upgrade rather than a prerequisite.
